unit: Neonatal starter PN bridge and complete daily-order lesson reconciliation

sources.title: ASPEN Clinical Considerations for Neonatal Starter Parenteral Nutrition
sources.method: Board-approved clinical considerations from narrative review and interprofessional expertise; not a new randomized trial or a universal patient protocol.
limits: No universal starter recipe, nutrient dose, catheter dwell policy, new peripheral osmolarity cutoff or beyond-use time adopted.
Commercial MCB recommendation limited to neonatal starter use and products then available in the United States.
No claim that all outsourced services were discontinued or that a current universal shortage exists.
Referenced primary studies and member-protected dosing resource not independently read or accessed.
The document does not resolve retained neonatal water-loss, brain/GIR or CKRT protein claims.

sources.title: ASPEN prescribing/order-review tools and prior complete source reviews
sources.bounds: Prior exact content/evidence snapshots reconciled for unchanged bodies/questions/figures; no claim of independently rereading every referenced full article this unit.

sourceDiscrepancies.issue: Observed scale-weight change was previously conflated with confirmed prescribed dosing weight.
sourceDiscrepancies.resolution: Fluid application and order application/keypoint now require confirmed dosing weight and clinical context; all original questions and teaching retained.

sourceDiscrepancies.issue: Historical commercial-product examples could imply neonatal starter suitability.
sourceDiscrepancies.resolution: Dated2026US starter context and specific composition/delivery/volume reasons added; product examples remain calculations/precautions.

sourceDiscrepancies.resolution: Not replaced by narrower teaching or marked complete. Human request for additional primary guidelines remains pending.
